description: Meeting start and end: chair-or-secretary start and chair-only end with roster checks and fan-out on end.
precondition: Published meeting with one chair and at least one secretary for Start; InProgress meeting for End.

cases.log: Saved: status InProgress, history row Start (Published to InProgress) with the Chair as actor; after commit "meeting started" notification queued for the two Members and the Secretary but not for the starter.
preconditions: Meeting is Published with exactly one active Chair (the actor) and one active Secretary.

cases.log: Saved: status Ended, history row End (InProgress to Ended); draft votes deleted; open speaking requests closed; after commit: agenda event "MeetingEnded" published, draft-deletion events sent to Chair and Secretary only, LiveKit room closed.
preconditions: Meeting is InProgress; actor is the active Chair.

cases.log: Same saved changes; no room closure because an in-person meeting has no online room.
